claimed_coverage: Tests that COSINE and INNER_PRODUCT distance metrics are correctly supported in IVF_FLAT index ingestion and querying, as added in fix.patch.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch adds flip_results() function for INNER_PRODUCT metric handling and normalize_vectors/normalize_vector functions for COSINE metric, modifying query results transformation and vector normalization during ingestion and querying.
issue_context_used: The issue.md context identifies the need for INNER_PRODUCT and COSINE distance metric support in the TileDB vector search library.
test_entrypoints: cd /workspace/apis/python && pytest test/test_distance_metrics.py -s -x -v --tb=short -k "test_cosine_distance or test_inner_product_distances or test_ivf_flat_cosine_simple or test_ivf_flat_ingestion_cosine"
notes: The eval.sh applies test.patch to add hidden verifier tests and conditionally applies fix.patch based on TEST_WITH_FIX environment variable. PYTHONPATH is set to /workspace/apis/python/src to ensure tests run against workspace code instead of pre-installed PyPI package.
